title: Launch Control: Travel Desk
tagline: Upgrade a live AI agent's prompt, tools, and model with no redeploy.
learning_objectives: configuring an AI agent at runtime
changing a model, prompt, and tools with no deploy

steps.title: Meet the travel booker
steps.hint: Tap the suggested trip, or write your own, and send it to the booker.
steps.done_when: The page's accessibility snapshot holds the line "booker-state v1 …" whose tried= list contains 1.

steps.title: Give it a real prompt
steps.hint: Let Pi switch the booker to v2, then send your trip again.
steps.done_when: The page's accessibility snapshot holds the line "booker-state v1 …" whose tried= list contains 2.

steps.title: Give it tools
steps.hint: Let Pi switch the booker to v3, then send your trip again.
steps.done_when: The page's accessibility snapshot holds the line "booker-state v1 …" whose tried= list contains 3.

steps.title: Upgrade its model
steps.hint: Let Pi switch the booker to v4, then send your trip again until it's booked.
steps.done_when: The page's accessibility snapshot holds the line "booker-state v1 …" whose tried= list contains 4 and which contains "booked=yes".

steps.title: Tell your guide what changed
steps.hint: Say what changed at each rung, and why nothing was redeployed.
steps.done_when: All four rungs are tried and the participant has told the guide, in their own words, what changed and why no deploy was needed.
